_doc._file: Template for Mason's private secrets file. Copy to ~/.config/mason/mason.secrets.json (dir 0700, file 0600) or run tools/migrate_secrets.py. Never commit the real file. An empty string means 'not set' (Mason then falls back to the env var, then the legacy mason.config.json). See docs/SECRETS.md.
_doc.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: Anthropic API key (console.anthropic.com > API Keys). Required. Env override: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.
_doc.APCA_API_KEY_ID: Alpaca PAPER trading API key ID (app.alpaca.markets > Paper account > API Keys). Required. Env override: APCA_API_KEY_ID.
_doc.APCA_API_SECRET_KEY: Alpaca PAPER trading API secret, shown once when the key is generated. Required. Env override: APCA_API_SECRET_KEY.
_doc.FMP_API_KEY: Financial Modeling Prep API key (site.financialmodelingprep.com > Dashboard). Required. Env override: FMP_API_KEY.
_doc.ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY: Alpha Vantage API key (www.alphavantage.co/support/#api-key). Required (backup quotes). Env override: ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY.
_doc.FRED_API_KEY: FRED API key (fred.stlouisfed.org > My Account > API Keys). Required for macro sources. Env override: FRED_API_KEY.
_doc.EIA_API_KEY: U.S. EIA API key (www.eia.gov/opendata/register.php). Required for energy sources. Env override: EIA_API_KEY.
_doc.FINVIZ_API_KEY: FinViz Elite API key, optional; only passed to the theme-detector skill subprocess. Env override: FINVIZ_API_KEY.
_doc.DATA_GOV_API_KEY: api.data.gov key (api.data.gov/signup), optional; congress.gov hearings for the events calendar. Sent in the X-Api-Key header. Env override: DATA_GOV_API_KEY.
_doc.SEC_USER_AGENT: SEC EDGAR fair-access User-Agent, e.g. 'Your Name your-email@example.com'. Optional; when empty Mason builds one from mason.owner. Env override: SEC_USER_AGENT.
_doc.ROBINHOOD_TOKEN_FILE: Path (not a secret value) of the Robinhood MCP OAuth token file. Optional; default ~/.config/mason/robinhood_oauth.json. Env override: ROBINHOOD_TOKEN_FILE.
_doc.TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID: Twilio Account SID. RETIRED: no Mason code reads it; kept only so migration does not lose it. Env override: TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID.
_doc.TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN: Twilio Auth Token. RETIRED: no Mason code reads it. Env override: TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN.
_doc.TWILIO_PHONE_NUMBER: Twilio sender phone number (E.164). RETIRED: no Mason code reads it. Env override: TWILIO_PHONE_NUMBER.

robinhood._doc: Private Robinhood account role map (RULINGS #2). Keys: the last 4 digits of the account number (5-8 digits only to break a collision); values: "personal" (analysed + displayed), "family" (displayed only), "hidden" (ignored). Generate a proposal with: python3 mason_robinhood.py last4-template. While accounts_by_last4 is empty ({}), this section counts as absent and Mason keeps the legacy label scope (RULINGS #24.1). Once it holds any entry, Mason switches to map mode and any account NOT listed is dropped.
